title: Translating microRNAs into clinical laboratory medicine: A critical review of biomarker potential, methodological barriers and implementation pathways.

snippet: This critical translational review evaluates the clinical significance of circulating microRNAs (miRNAs) across a broad spectrum of medical disciplines, identifies the main barriers to routine laboratory implementation and proposes a practical roadmap toward clinical use.
